name: PeriodicSpeedUpdate
description: Emits periodic summary updates of average speed and confidence for each source over a fixed time window.
epl: @Name('PeriodicSpeedUpdate') select e.src as sourceId, avg(e.value) as avgSpeed, avg(e.confidence) as avgConfidence from Event.win:time(5 sec) as e group by e.src

name: HighSpeed
description: Detects individual speed observations that exceed a high-speed threshold.
epl: @Name('HighSpeed') select e from Event as e where e.value > 120

name: LowConfidenceSpeed
description: Detects speed events with reduced confidence, typically indicating reconstructed or degraded observations.
epl: @Name('LowConfidenceSpeed') select e from Event as e where e.confidence < 0.7

name: BothFast
description: Detects correlated high-speed behavior across both simulated sources within a short time window.
epl: @Name('BothFast') select a as firstEvt, b as secondEvt from pattern [ every a=Event(value > 110) -> b=Event(src != a.src and value > 110) where timer:within(3 sec) ]

name: SustainedHighSpeed
description: Detects sustained high-speed behavior from the same source across consecutive observations.
epl: @Name('SustainedHighSpeed') select a as firstEvt, b as nextEvt from pattern [ every a=Event(value > 100) -> b=Event(src = a.src and value > 100) where timer:within(4 sec) ]
